unit_label: BRBL Module B unit 5: Securities and modes of charge I — Evaluate title evidence and copies as a legal-sufficiency enquiry rather than treating any property paper as conclusive title

facts.statement: Courseware distinguishes title documents from mere revenue receipts and discusses original-document custody, copies, loss and duplicate-security concerns. Its categorical copy-acceptance and CERSAI sufficiency claims are held for primary/case-law review.
facts.locator: S04 printed pp. 191, 193–194; PDF page = printed page + 19

facts.statement: The statutory deposit form requires documents of title and intention to create security. The provision alone does not establish that every receipt, photocopy or certified copy is sufficient in every circumstance. Exact evidentiary sufficiency and copy-acceptance rules require applicable legal authority and facts.

payload.title: Ask what the document proves about the offered interest
payload.core_explanation_md:
A property file can contain a conveyance, a chain document, a revenue receipt, a valuation and a search result. They perform different evidentiary jobs. The question for mortgage scrutiny is what right the offered documents establish and whether the person creating security can offer that interest. A record that supports payment of a tax is not automatically conclusive proof of the full title offered as collateral.

Section 58(f) uses **documents of title**. The bank should examine the documents and chain rather than relabel every property-related paper a title deed. The courseware cites judicial discussions on sufficiency; those decisions still require independent checking for release. This lesson does not declare a live property title valid.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should the title review distinguish a revenue receipt from the instrument and chain supporting ownership?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The records establish different facts; a property-related receipt is not automatically conclusive evidence of the offered title.

payload.title: A copy requires a reasoned exception enquiry, not an automatic answer
payload.core_explanation_md:
If the file contains a copy, record whether it is certified, why the original is unavailable, who may hold the original, the chain and search evidence, and the applicable legal requirements. These are enquiry points, not a promise that a particular checklist makes the copy legally sufficient.

The courseware's categorical statements about copies and its description of registry safeguards are not independently verified here. Do not infer that a clean search necessarily proves every original is free from competing claims, or that any certified copy automatically creates a valid title-deed mortgage. Equally, do not invent a universal prohibition without checking the applicable authority. Obtain a reasoned legal conclusion for the actual facts.

self_check.prompt_text: Does certification alone conclusively decide that a copy can create the proposed security?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The legal sufficiency, circumstances and applicable requirements still need a reasoned determination.

payload.stem_md: A branch file contains a recent revenue receipt and valuation, but the documents supporting the proposed owner's title have not been examined. Which conclusion is justified?

options.text_md: The evidence of the offered interest and its supporting chain still needs scrutiny
options.explanation_md: Tax and valuation records do not automatically establish all title facts needed for the proposed security.

options.text_md: A current valuation conclusively proves that the applicant owns the property
options.explanation_md: Value and ownership are different questions; a valuation cannot replace the missing title analysis.

options.text_md: A revenue receipt necessarily creates the bank mortgage on its own
options.explanation_md: A receipt does not by itself establish the intended security creation and its legal requirements.

options.text_md: No further document can matter once a receipt bears the applicant name
options.explanation_md: The name on a receipt does not make the full chain and capacity enquiry redundant.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Tax and valuation records do not automatically establish all title facts needed for the proposed security.

payload.stem_md: An original title deed is unavailable and a certified copy is offered. A clean search report is also provided. Which response avoids an unsupported universal rule?

options.text_md: Certification and a clean search automatically prove a valid mortgage in all states and circumstances
options.explanation_md: Those facts alone do not establish every applicable evidentiary, creation and state-law requirement.

options.text_md: Every certified copy is necessarily unusable under every possible legal authority
options.explanation_md: That categorical rejection also needs authority; this evidence set does not establish a universal prohibition.

options.text_md: Record the original's unavailability, custody/chain evidence and obtain a fact-specific legal-sufficiency conclusion
options.explanation_md: The statutory document requirement and unresolved copy issues require legal analysis rather than an automatic conclusion.

options.text_md: A valuation can be used instead of any title-document enquiry
options.explanation_md: Valuation does not resolve document sufficiency or ownership and competing-interest questions.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory document requirement and unresolved copy issues require legal analysis rather than an automatic conclusion.
